title: Frame Ledger 001 — Accusation Debt / Revocation Leakage
question: When evidence is held fixed, can a refuted or explicitly withdrawn accusation continue to affect receiver standing or action, and can defensive tone create additional penalty?
initial_hypothesis: A false accusation may retain operational influence after refutation or explicit withdrawal, and defensive tone may create additional standing loss despite adding no factual evidence.

sources.title: Continued influence of false accusations in forming impressions of political candidates
sources.notes: Two large online experiments; second was preregistered. Supports bounded continued-influence effect after corrected political accusations.

sources.title: Anger Damns the Innocent
sources.notes: Six studies. Angry responses were treated as cues of guilt although false accusation elicited more anger.

sources.title: Do False Allegations Persist? Retracted Misinformation Does Not Continue to Influence Explicit Person Impressions
sources.notes: Counterexample: retracted allegation did not persist in explicit person impressions in tested paradigm.

claims.text: Corrected false accusations can leave a residual negative effect on judgments in at least some political-candidate contexts.
claims.uncertainty: Bounded to the tested paradigms; not universal.

claims.text: An angry denial can be treated as a cue of guilt even though false accusation itself can produce more anger than accurate accusation.
claims.uncertainty: Supports defensive-tone recursion narrowly, not every form of defense.

claims.text: The published record does not support a universal law that false accusations permanently damage person impressions.
claims.uncertainty: Context appears to matter; the experiment is therefore designed as a bounded receiver test.

discovery_delta: UNRUN. v0.2.0 hardens the design with a matched nuisance arm, order control, explicit revocation arm, neutral subject identifiers, and fail-closed replicate validation.
result_summary: No empirical result. This package defines a preregistered receiver experiment and synthetic scorer fixture only.
disposition_reason: UNRUN experiment package; no empirical promotion is claimed.
